instagram.caption:
In 2005 a plague spread through World of Warcraft and killed thousands of players' characters.

A raid boss's curse, Corrupted Blood, was meant to stay in his dungeon. Pets carried it into the big cities, where weaker characters died in seconds.

Some players fled, some stayed to heal strangers, some spread it on purpose. Real epidemiologists later studied it to learn how people act in an outbreak.

Were you playing back then?
